_comment: Pins that DIFFER from the wiki on purpose, with the reason. Same idea as
quest-granted-reviewed.json: without a place to record 'looked at this,
it is correct', an audit re-reports every settled decision forever and
Add an entry only when you can say WHY ours is better. 'Looks fine' is
not a reason - leave it flagged.

reviewed.ardy general store: Hand-corrected to Aemad's after audit-shops found the town-page pin was a random landmark (wave 6).
reviewed.castle wars: The lobby the minigame teleport lands in, which is where you actually arrive. The wiki pin is the arena floor (wave 31).
reviewed.evil dave: The trapdoor in Edgeville. His basement is not routable and the wiki page pins him at his Recipe for Disaster spot in Lumbridge (wave 31).
reviewed.fortis colosseum: Outside the Colosseum. The wiki pin is inside it, on tiles Shortest Path cannot stand on (wave 31).
reviewed.karamja: Musa Point, not the jungle. The wiki pin at 2843,3070 is ~120 tiles from any landing and the step ticked in the field (wave 12).
reviewed.moons of peril: The routable tile inside Neypotzli. The wiki pin sits in the wall between chambers (wave 31).
reviewed.tempoross: The rope ladder at the Ruins of Unkah. The wiki pin is the island itself, which is only reachable by the ship and only once the game starts (wave 31).
reviewed.tempoross cove: Same as tempoross: the boarding ladder, not the island (wave 31).
reviewed.zmi bank: Surface entrance of the Ourania Cave. Shortest Path cannot draw a route into a cave interior, so interiors are anchored at the way in (wave 5).
